# glad2 Generated Source Boundary

This directory is reserved for reviewed OpenGL loader source generated by **glad2 v2.0.8**.

## Locked generation contract

```text
upstream: Dav1dde/glad
version/tag: v2.0.8
API: OpenGL 4.6 Core
language: C
loader: enabled
extensions: explicit project-required set only
```

The vcpkg package named `glad` at the TA16-V1 registry baseline is glad 0.1.36 (glad1) and is intentionally **not** used as a substitute.

Generated files enter this directory in the renderer implementation phase together with:

- exact generator invocation/options;
- upstream/generated license notices;
- a reviewable generated-source diff;
- an OpenGL loader/backend smoke test.

No gameplay module may include the generated glad headers directly. OpenGL symbols remain inside the StarForge platform/render ownership boundary.
